      "observations": [
        "All seven owned files and all 297 new test lines were read. The static Boolean pref defaults true. Plain and flowed parse_begin reset the counter and snapshot that pref; exact fixed/flowed parse_line guards, replay helper, quote/signature consumers, and EOF paths were inspected. The literal grep of the new counter shows no EOF replay call.",
        "The feature counts eligible empty lines rather than retaining their bytes. A following nonempty/nondeferred line flushes the count with renderer-specific output: MSG_LINEBREAK for fixed text, newline plus br for flowed text. A run left at EOF is not flushed. Negative MimeObject_write status returns immediately; only successful entries decrement. This is source-level state/output behavior, not a measured memory or rendering result.",
        "Fixed text only counts a leading CR/LF while conversion is active, the prior cite level is zero, and signature state is false. A blank that must first close a quote follows existing state transitions rather than that early return. Flowed text additionally checks both current linequotelevel and previous quotelevel after quote/space-stuff parsing. Decompose-file output returns before the flowed conversion gate; fixed raw filter/attach and forced-charset/no-converter paths bypass it. No blanket claim that all plain-text modes or signatures are stripped.",
        "The new tests generate eight tasks from four scenarios times two renderers: long padded tail, missing final line ending, retained interior gaps, and preference off. One fixed-only task checks quote closing and at most two final breaks. Two additional tasks stream a multipart/mixed fixture with literal Sig: t=p; b=AAAA and check content/interior/trailing breaks. This is synthetic MIME shape coverage, not signature validity or cryptographic verification.",
        "Direct tests count final LF or br markup and interior breaks. textNewlinesBetween removes tags with a regular expression and counts literal newlines; it does not call a DOM textContent property. Comments explain the intended text-reader contract, but these assertions establish only the string checks present in the test. All added assertion sites have nonempty expected-result messages; missing should alone in another author's wording is not a defect.",
        "Cleanup is registered at module evaluation before task execution and clears the new preference. The file-channel helper writes a raw test file so the missing-final-CRLF scenario avoids the message-store append path.
